feeds.h1: Everything being published right now, in one place
feeds.lead: Ekteb watches the sources you follow around the clock and turns every clip and article into a summarised, translated, tagged item your team can pick from.

feeds.moreP: Inside Ekteb, items arrive the moment they are published, with a full translation and transcript, and become a publish-ready video in one click.

features.h2_html:
A smarter way to edit video,
faster than ever.
features.lead: Ekteb takes the slow manual work off your plate, so you produce and publish more without compromising quality.

f1.p: Cut, trim, reframe, zoom, blur, subtitle, template, audio, and cover art — all in a browser-based editor. Take the AI's suggestions or adjust every detail by hand before you sign off.

f2.p: It knows who is speaking and when, and splits the text by speaker automatically — instead of someone spending hours transcribing and labelling. Source and translation sit side by side on the timeline, with subtitles styled to match your brand and lift completion rates.
f2.demo2Tr: This is where it all begins

f3.p: Upload your logo, colours, fonts, templates, and tone of voice once. Everything Ekteb produces after that comes out consistent with your brand — no redesign or reformatting per item.
f3.cap: Video statement from an official body

f4.h3: A cover suggested for every video
f4.p: Ekteb proposes covers from the strongest frames, in the sizes each social platform needs.

f5.h3: Ekteb knows who is on screen
f5.p: Pick a face and Ekteb finds every appearance, collects the shots, and reframes the video around them automatically.

f6.p: Pick your channels, set the time, and Ekteb publishes on schedule.

usecases.h2_html:
Ekteb is for every team
publishing every day
usecases.lead: From newsrooms to agencies and creators, Ekteb shortens the distance between raw footage and a finished post.

items.p: News agencies and TV channels producing video daily, at volume, across several languages.
YouTubers and influencers who want to scale their video output and reach a global audience without the overhead.
Companies running social accounts that need a steady stream of multilingual video every day.
For brands that want professional, localized video for global markets, fast.

enterprise.h2: Built to meet your organization's requirements

items.p: A clear data retention policy, and your content is never used to train models.
Roles, groups, and granular permissions at the project and item level.
An open API, plus integrations with publishing platforms and media libraries.
A full RTL interface and a team working in your timezone.

items.q: What kind of content can I start from?
items.a: Upload a video, paste a link, add an article, or pick an item from the visual feed. In every case Ekteb creates a single project and starts preparing the content inside it.
Ekteb translates and generates content in multiple languages with near-native accuracy, so you can reach a global audience without the overhead.

A discovery surface that gathers new material from more than 1,500 accounts and sources. Ekteb analyzes around 20,000 videos a day, drops duplicates and weak material, then ranks about 200 items by priority and editorial fit.

items.q: Can I edit the output before approving it?
items.a: Yes. Every output is reviewable and editable — transcript, translation, title, description, clips, cover, and template. The final call always stays with your team.

items.q: How does Ekteb keep my brand consistent?
items.a: Templates, logo, colours, fonts, subtitle styling, and tags are stored in the platform, then applied automatically to new material.

items.q: Which channels can I publish to?
items.a: Ekteb publishes to YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and Telegram. Publish immediately or schedule for later.

items.q: How does our team get started?
items.a: We start with an onboarding session to understand your workflow, then set up templates, connect accounts, and train your users on discovery, production, review, and publishing.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | Ekteb
meta.description: How the Ekteb mobile app collects, uses and protects your data, and how to delete your account.

privacy.intro_html: This Privacy Policy explains how Ekteb (“Ekteb”, “we”, “us”) collects, uses and protects information when you use the Ekteb mobile app for iOS and Android (the “App”). By using the App you agree to the practices described here.

sections.body_html:
We collect only what the App needs to work:

  • Account information: your name, your email address and, where applicable, the organisation you belong to. Passwords are stored only in hashed form.
  • Content you provide: the projects, texts, subtitles, files and media you create, upload or save in the App.
  • Notification data: if you allow notifications, a push-notification token for your device and its platform (iOS or Android), so we can tell you when your content is ready. The token is removed when you sign out.

The App does not collect your precise location or your contacts, does not track you for advertising, and accesses files on your device only when you choose to upload them.

We use the information we collect to:

  • provide, operate and maintain the App and your account;
  • process the content you submit, for example to transcribe, translate, subtitle or summarise it;
  • send you notifications about your content, if you allow them;
  • keep the App and its users secure and prevent misuse;
  • answer your messages and requests.

We do not sell your data, use it for advertising, or build advertising profiles from it.

We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties. To deliver notifications, the App uses Firebase Cloud Messaging (provided by Google) and Apple’s push notification service; they receive only your device’s notification token and the text of the notification, not your account information or your content.

We may also disclose information where the law requires it or a competent authority issues a valid order.

We keep account information and content for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we delete your personal data and content within 30 days, including from backups. Notification tokens are deleted when you sign out of the App.

Data is encrypted in transit using TLS, and access to it is limited to the staff who need it to run the service. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your information and to deal with any incident promptly.

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to correct it, to delete it, to receive a copy of it, and to object to or restrict its processing. To exercise any of these rights, write to privacy@ekteb.ai from the email address on your account. We reply within 30 days.

You can ask us to delete your account at any time by sending a deletion request to privacy@ekteb.ai from the email address on your account.

Deleting your account permanently removes your personal data and content as described under “Data retention”. It cannot be undone.

The App is a professional tool intended for users aged 18 and over. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page shows when it last changed, and we will tell you in the App before any material change takes effect.
For any question about this policy or your data, contact us at privacy@ekteb.ai.

funnel.title: Ekteb | From 20,000 items to one ready story
funnel.srDesc: Ekteb analyzes around twenty thousand items a day — video and written reports — drops duplicates and weak material, then ranks about two hundred items by priority and fit. One item becomes a project with transcript, translation, and brand applied, ready for review and then for publishing to YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and Telegram.
